en: Volvo Penta engine plant in Wuxi (Volvo Penta / Wuxi Diesel Engine Works)

1: The plant, located in Wuxi, about 100 kilometers west of Shanghai, is jointly owned by Volvo Penta and its Chinese partner, Wuxi Diesel Engine Works.
Inaugurated in the beginning of 2000, the plant assembles diesel engines delivered as CKD kits, primarily from Volvo’s engine plant in Skövde, Sweden.
Production involves diesel engines used in industrial applications, mainly generator sets, as well as in various types of workboats and passenger vessels.
now has a capacity of 10,000 engines annually

str: Nhà máy liên doanh Volvo Penta – Wuxi Diesel Engine Works ở Vô Tích, lắp động cơ diesel từ bộ CKD (chủ yếu từ nhà máy Skövde, Thụy Điển), chủ yếu cho tổ máy phát
Công suất khoảng 10.000 động cơ/năm (thông cáo 01/2005)

lines.s: Industrial diesel engines (mainly for generator sets)
